newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian dies in blast at West Bank blacksmith.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian dies in blast at West Bank blacksmith.

text.p: A Palestinian man was killed on Monday when a shell exploded at a blacksmith's shop near the town of Nablus in the West Bank, hospital and Israeli military sources said.
An official at Nablus's Rafidia hospital said Abdel Jawad Abdullah, 48, died of his injuries following the blast in Huwwara village south of the town.
Military sources said the blast occurred when an unexploded shell was heated and the blacksmith, Youssef Hadawi, was injured in the explosion.
They said soldiers also discovered "four parts of shells", which military sources had earlier described as "improvised charges".
The area is under Palestinian civilian rule but remains under Israeli security control.
Local residents said Hadawi and Abdullah, a vegetable seller, had not known they were handling explosives.
A relative of Hadawi's said Abdullah had found the pieces of metal and wanted them turned into weights for a scale.
Israel has been on high alert since a double suicide bombing in a market in Jerusalem last month. Sixteen people, including the two Arab bombers, were killed.
